Lore: Relic

A three-compartment quiver, each compartment far deeper than the outside of it suggests.

  • Holding 3: Occupies 1 Inventory Slot, but can hold 3 Slots of Items without counting against the carrier's Inventory Slots.

Value: 1000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
